hollow_rule: Unified hollow, open-mesh, porous, and composite mass rule (shared across T0, T1, and T2 under #173 / #175): solid `class_density * collider_volume_m3` applies only where the object is an approximately homogeneous solid and its USD collider encloses solid material without unmodelled cavities or overlapping helper primitives. Whenever bulk density times outer-hull/closed-mesh/helper volume is inapplicable, three deterministic sub-regimes apply across T1 and T2: (A) Closed thin-wall USD shell (`Rigid/broom_shovel/00000` in T1; any T2 vessel whose USD mesh explicitly models finite wall thickness with `V_wall << V_hull`): `mass_kg = class_bulk_density * V_wall` (`status: estimated`) with closed-surface thin-shell COM and I/m. (B) Standard hollow electronics enclosures (`abs_device_housing` without heavy metal mechanisms: 10 T1 models `alarm/00000`, `earbuds/0000{0,1,2}`, `keyboard/0000{0,1,2}`, `mouse/0000{4,6,7}`, plus T2 electronics housings): `mass_kg = 450 [200, 1000] kg/m^3 * V_hull` (`class_values.json` effective shell+PCB envelope density, `estimated`) with outer-hull thin-shell COM and I/m. (C) Product-range estimates (`status: estimated`, one explicit basis line per model, matching T0 bottles and `cup/00001`): applied to all open-mesh concave tools/figurines, hollow vessels/containers/figurines/bricks whose USD mesh closes an interior cavity (`brick/0000{0,1,2}` in T1; `hollow_contents_dependent` in T2, paired with `full` mass on sealed liquid containers), overlapping-helper-collider parts (`key/00000`), porous/crumpled objects (`paper_ball/*`), and heavy-mechanism housings (`tape_measure/00000`) — 18 models in T1 and the 105 `hollow_contents_dependent` models in T2. Every Sub-regime C model is cross-checked against `decomp_mass_kg = class_density_nominal * V_decomp` (PhysX V-HACD `convexDecomposition` hull union, primary SDF mesh volume, or primitive part union); whenever `max(est / decomp_mass_kg, decomp_mass_kg / est) > 2.0`, the row is flagged (`decomp_crosscheck_disagrees_gt_2x`) with both values and the physical cause rather than picked silently.
